𝗙𝗢𝗥 𝗦𝗔𝗟𝗘 ✨ Your Lake Belton escape is waiting! 🌊🌅

📍 Morgan’s Point Resort · Belton, TX
💵 $149,000 | 🛏️ Studio | 🛁 1 Bath | 📐 420 SQFT

Enjoy peaceful lake views, beautiful sunsets, and resort-style amenities from this charming lakeside studio condo.

✨ Private covered balcony with Lake Belton views
🍳 Open-concept living and kitchen space
🏡 Updated kitchen with modern finishes
🧺 Washer and dryer inside the unit
❄️ Split-unit A/C
🏊 Private community pool

🔥 Outdoor seating, grills and fire pit
🚤 Nearby marina and lake access
🛶 Kayak, paddleboard and canoe storage
🎾 Tennis and basketball courts
🌳 Park and playground nearby

Whether you’re looking for a weekend retreat, a low-maintenance home, or an investment opportunity, this condo offers a relaxing Lake Belton lifestyle at an incredible price.

📞 Call or text to schedule your private showing!

🗝️ Sujin Park Henson, REALTOR®
